content.value_statement: Database work often spans schema design, migrations, optimization, operations, and data pipelines. This skill provides a structured workflow and prompt set for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Breaks database work into design, implementation, optimization, migration, pipeline, quality, and operations phases.
Lists specialist skills for PostgreSQL, NoSQL, Prisma, migrations, data pipelines, and database administration.
Provides copy-paste prompts for common database workflow phases.
Defines quality gates for schema review, migration testing, backups, monitoring, and documentation.
Maps technology workflows for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and data warehousing.
limitations: Does not include executable migration scripts or database client integrations.
Depends on referenced specialist skills being available in the user environment.
Does not connect to live databases or inspect real schemas by itself.
Requires human review before production database changes are applied.

use_cases.title: Design Application Schemas
use_cases.description: Plan tables, relationships, indexes, and ORM setup before application development starts.

use_cases.title: Build Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Organize ingestion, transformation, scheduling, monitoring, and data quality work for analytics pipelines.

use_cases.title: Prepare Operational Reviews
use_cases.description: Use quality gates to review backups, replication, monitoring, capacity, and security tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Database Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new application database.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to plan a new application database. Include schema goals, entities, relationships, indexes, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create Migration Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to plan a safe migration from the current schema to the target schema. Include tests and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Query Performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of slow database queries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to review slow queries. Identify execution plan checks, index changes, caching options, and benchmark criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Data Platform Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination across database and data engineering teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database workflow to coordinate schema design, migrations, data pipelines, quality checks, operations, and specialist skill handoffs.

output_examples.input: I need to design a PostgreSQL schema for a new product feature.
output: A phased plan covering requirements, entities, relationships, index strategy, and scalability review.
Suggested specialist handoffs for PostgreSQL design, ORM setup, and migration planning.
Quality gates for schema review, migration testing, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Our analytics pipeline needs better quality checks and monitoring.
output: A workflow for ingestion, transformations, scheduling, validation, monitoring, and alerting.
Recommended checkpoints for data quality metrics, ownership, and operational documentation.

output_examples.input: We have slow database queries and need a structured review.
output: A performance review path covering execution plans, index review, query refactoring, caching, and benchmark targets.
A checklist for confirming improvements with monitoring data before deployment.

best_practices: Review schema and migration plans with application and data owners before implementation.
Test migrations and rollback paths in staging before production changes.
Pair optimization work with benchmarks, execution plans, and monitoring data.
anti_patterns: Running migrations without backups, tests, or rollback criteria.
Optimizing queries before confirming the performance bottleneck with evidence.
Treating data quality, monitoring, and documentation as optional follow-up work.

faq.question: Does this skill run database commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a planning workflow and does not include executable command logic.

faq.question: Can it design SQL and NoSQL databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and data warehousing workflows at a planning level.

faq.question: Does it require other skills?
faq.answer: It references specialist skills for deeper work. Availability depends on the installed skill set.

faq.question: Is it safe for production changes?
faq.answer: Use it for planning and review. Production changes still require testing, backups, approval, and rollback plans.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it include data pipeline guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers ingestion, transformation, scheduling, monitoring, and data quality phases.
